name: Ichinose Marika
source:
Hobbies: Helping out people in need
Likes: The everyday life
Dislikes: Rule breakers
A student at St. Julian Girls' Academy, she is the student council president who enjoys taking care of others.
She is always visiting the storehouse behind the gymnasium, trying to find a way to get Kyoko to attend classes.
In fact, she has special feelings for Kyoko, but she herself is not aware of it yet.
